questions.stem: You have a project with 5 branches: main, feature1, feature2, bugfix, and release. If you merge feature1 and feature2 into main, how many branches will remain? Provide your answer as a number.
questions.explanation: Merging branches into the main branch does not delete them. Therefore, all 5 branches (main, feature1, feature2, bugfix, and release) will still exist unless explicitly deleted.

questions.stem: Explain the advantages of using feature branching in a collaborative software development project.
markingGuide: Isolates feature development from the main codebase.
Allows multiple features to be developed simultaneously.
Facilitates testing and integration of individual features.
Reduces the risk of introducing bugs into the main branch.
questions.explanation: Feature branching allows developers to work on new features in isolation, reducing the risk of introducing bugs into the main branch. It also enables simultaneous development of multiple features and facilitates testing and integration.
